_note: CHUNK-TAXO-CORE-1109 + JOB. job.text_chars defaults to 8000 characters per chunk sent to the embedder (was 1000): bge-m3 accepts long inputs (limit 60000 tokens), so this keeps most chunks whole; longer chunks are still split and the part vectors averaged. Neuron cost scales with characters (about chars/3 tokens at 1075 neurons per million tokens, so 8000 chars is about 2.9 neurons per chunk at most; the daily_neuron_budget of 8000 still bounds the day). Domain-only back-offs get no stored link: WP6 counts them as unlabelled. Flag off by default. All thresholds for vera/chunk_taxo.py; gate thresholds are starting values to be calibrated on real data and only control whether the Corpus page DISPLAYS the taxonomy. Outbound control (OD-1109-DEMB-3): the only outbound host is api.cloudflare.com, pinned in code (vera/chunk_taxo_embed.py HOST, https) and no api_permissions.json entry is added; server-side LLM calls such as api.groq.com are not governed by that gate. send_allowed true follows v3.8a (Cloudflare data-use terms confirmed); the flag stays off until the owner-ordered release steps are done.
